note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground 50 km southeast of Robb on Hwy 40, run by West Fraser Mills with the Fox Creek Development Association. Spacious, private sites in three loops in the forest near Fairfax Lake; boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning stations and free firewood. Hand-pump water is for putting out fires only, so bring drinking water. West Fraser says Hwy 40 can be rough in wet spring weather. --Claude
summary: Read the AP page (Apr 17, 2026), West Fraser's page and the campground map: C$20 (C$15 seniors), C$10 reservation fee, May 1 - Oct 31, 27 sites in 3 loops, mixed reservable (by phone with Fox Creek Development) and FCFS, pump water for fires only. Not waterfront kept. DROP CANDIDATE: West Fraser recommends 4WD or high clearance on Hwy 40 in wet spring weather.
